news.headline: Pakistan beat Nepal to set up U-19 Asia Cup semi-final against Bangladesh
news.summary:
<p>Defending champions Pakistan maintained their unbeaten run in the ACC Men’s U-19 Asia Cup 2026 with a convincing 101-run victory over Nepal at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Muscat on Tuesday.</p>
